issues.detail: Spec does not define same-posedge vs next-posedge assertion after 1101; contract selects same_cycle and marks r_set_or_hold uncertain.
issues.spec_evidence: When the sequence is found, it should set start_shifting to 1, forever, until reset.
issues.alternative: Assert start_shifting only on the next sampled posedge after the completing data=1 (next_cycle).

issues.detail: Rule asserts start_shifting=0 while reset==1, but spec only states active-high synchronous reset; reset value for start_shifting is not specified.
Rule clears start_shifting to 0 when not found, but spec only says to set it to 1 when found; pre-found/default output value is not verbatim specified.
